name: Pennar Industries Limited
summary: Pennar Industries Limited operates as an engineering company in India and internationally. The company offers pre-engineered buildings; process heat and industrial power boilers; and precision tubes, such as electric resistance welding, CWE/DOM/CEW, bicycle frame, steel, engineering, boiler, heat exchanger, propeller shaft, transformer, fuel and air, furniture, structural, telescopic front fork, and air pre-heater tubes, as well as automotive shock absorbers; and railway wagons, passenger and metro coaches, railway coach components, cold roll formed profiles, other fabricated parts, wagon and locomotive components.
